answer: Each epoch auctions 60 velvet-rope seats to block fake identities: one sealed bid and a 50-credit bond each. The bid is a costly signal of real work. Winners take a unique pigment seal; auditors replay bids: two winners sharing one pigment seal, or one key renting many bids, are clones; both bonds burn. First fake 48, k-th 48+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,045,000, 50,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once, keep bond and share.
